subject: Vendr staging: temporary cred & proof curation check-in
messages:
From: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 17 Jun 2025 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr staging access & manifest (initial)

Hi Grace —

Thanks again for slotting Vendr into your staging window next week. Two quick asks so our evidence staging can proceed without a follow-up: 

1) Can you confirm the preferred approach for temporary upload credentials (presigned S3 vs short-lived service account)? We typically accept presigned manifests but customers sometimes prefer delegated temp creds.
2) Attached is a draft staging manifest (vendr_staging_manifest.csv) and a short note on S3 presign conventions (s3_presign_instructions.md). If you could review and confirm what fields we should include and any naming conventions, we’ll lock the bundle.

Targeting a 2025-06-23 upload if that works for Redwood.

Thanks —
Ethan Lowe
Onboarding Lead, Vendr
attachments: vendr_staging_manifest.csv (text/csv), s3_presign_instructions.md (text/markdown)

From: grace_oconnor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 18 Jun 2025 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr staging access & manifest (initial)

Ethan —

Thanks for the manifest and instructions. Quick responses below and a couple of asks so Ben and Marissa can act on the config: 

- Preferred approach: presigned S3 manifests for this staging window. We can provide short TTL presigns (24h) scoped to the upload prefix. That reduces operator rollout on our side and keeps audit trails clean.
- Required manifest fields: Please ensure the CSV includes: object_key, size_bytes, sha256_hex, content_type, created_by, timestamp_utc. Your draft looks close but missing created_by.
- Naming convention: please prefix with vendr/staging/{account_short}/YYYYMMDD/ and avoid whitespace.

Ben — can you prepare a short lifecycle policy and the presign endpoint (we should use a tokenized preauth link) and drop the manifest template back to the Drive link so Vendr can reupload. Marissa — can you validate that the evidence mapping includes the SOC2:CC6 and SIG:Data_Protection fields?

If we get the updated manifest by EOD Friday (2025-06-20), we’ll be good for the 23rd slot.

Best,
Grace O’Connor
Security Programs, Redwood Inference
redwood-inference.com

From: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr staging access & manifest (initial)

Grace — quick update:

- I created a temporary presign service route (one-off token) that will mint 24h presigned PUTs to the prefix you specified. I’ll push the endpoint URL to the Drive manifest (see link).
- Lifecycle: objects under vendr/staging/* will be auto-expired after 30 days; retention policy set to keep raw evidence for 90 days before archival. That meets Vendr’s audit ask.

Link to presign endpoint & manifest: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1A2B3C4D-vendr-staging-manifest

Marissa — I tagged the SIG fields in the manifest header (Data_Protection, Access_Control). Please confirm mapping.

—Ben
Security Ops

To: Vendr Onboarding <onboarding@vendr.com>, grace_oconnor@redwood.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 19 Jun 2025 09:34:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr staging access & manifest (initial)

Ethan / Vendr team — thanks, that looks good. I pulled your updated manifest; I added the created_by column and a sample row to demonstrate the naming pattern. Two minor asks before we call this green: 

1) Can you include the evidence_type field (e.g., soc2_pdf, config_dump, access_log) so our parser can group artifacts automatically?
2) For any SOC2 reports included, add a textual reference in the report_note column that indicates the report period (e.g., "SOC2 Type II — period: 2024-10 to 2025-04"). That helps downstream cataloging.

Once those are in, we’ll proceed with the presign tokens and confirm the 06/23 staging window.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole
Vendor Security Intake, Redwood Inference
attachments referenced: vendr_staging_manifest.csv
